errors.text_span: Етикетите на оста са равномерно разпределени през интервали от една година.
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the x-axis are not uniformly distributed, nor are they at one-year intervals. The intervals are 2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2025, 2030.

errors.text_span: Оста Y е озаглавена "Цена за USD/kWh"
errors.evidence: The Y-axis is labeled "USD". "Цена за USD/kWh" is the label for the data series in the legend.

errors.text_span: Етикетите на оста са равномерно разпределени през интервали от 100 USD/kWh.
errors.evidence: The intervals between the Y-axis labels are 200 USD, not 100 USD.
The starting value in 2010 is clearly 1200 USD, not 1120.
The value in 2016 is closer to 300 USD, not 350 USD.

errors.text_span: След това линията остава приблизително стабилна, като се колебае около 200 USD/kWh между 2016 и 2020 година
errors.evidence: The line does not remain stable; it shows a clear and continuous decrease from approximately 300 USD in 2016 to around 140 USD in 2020. This is not a fluctuation around 200 USD.
The value in 2030 is much lower, at approximately 70 USD. The value of 170 USD corresponds roughly to the year 2018, not 2030.
